column1: # agent-ready.tsv — the Agent Device Ready standard (profile: agent-node).
# One source for check, apply and report: scripts/agent-ready.sh reads this file,
# tests/test_agent_ready.sh guards that every id has its functions.
# A machine is agent-ready when an agent can reach it, run long work on it, and
# trust what it reports — with nobody sitting in front of it.
# Format: id TAB layer TAB mode TAB description-en TAB description-zh
#   mode:  auto   — agent-ready.sh --apply fixes it (and reads it back)
#          manual — needs a human once (GUI login, browser sign-in); --check tells you
#          check  — owned by another tool (shell config / pipeline); only verified here

column4: Remote Login (sshd) enabled
column5: 远程登录（sshd）已开启

column4: ~/.ssh/authorized_keys present with 700/600 permissions
column5: ~/.ssh/authorized_keys 存在且权限 700/600

column4: sshd refuses password and keyboard-interactive logins
column5: sshd 拒绝密码与键盘交互登录

column4: sudo works without a password (validated sudoers.d drop-in)
column5: sudo 免密（sudoers.d 文件经 visudo 校验）

column4: Remote users have Full Disk Access (sshd-keygen-wrapper)
column5: 远程用户拥有完全磁盘访问权限

column4: `ssh host cmd` sees brew, git, tmux, claude, node and npx (non-interactive PATH)
column5: 非交互 SSH 能找到 brew / git / tmux / claude / node / npx

column4: Tailscale signed in and running
column5: Tailscale 已登录并运行

column4: Tailscale starts at every login (LaunchAgent, independent of the app's own toggle)
column5: 每次登录自动启动 Tailscale（LaunchAgent，不依赖应用自带开关）

column4: System and disks never sleep (display may)
column5: 系统与磁盘永不睡眠（显示器可以）

column4: Boots by itself after a power failure
column5: 断电恢复后自动开机

column4: Wakes for network access
column5: 网络唤醒已开启

column4: macOS major/minor updates are not auto-installed (security responses still are)
column5: macOS 系统更新不自动安装（安全响应仍自动）

column4: Reboot is recoverable remotely (FileVault off, or SSH pre-boot unlock available)
column5: 重启后可远程恢复（FileVault 关闭，或支持 SSH 预启动解锁）

column4: The agent user is logged in at the console (keychain is reachable)
column5: agent 用户已在本机图形界面登录（钥匙串可用）

column4: A tmux server lives in the GUI session, so dispatched sessions can use the keychain
column5: tmux server 运行在图形会话内，下发的会话可访问钥匙串

column4: 1Password Service Account token usable by `op` (token file 600; set AGENT_OP_TOKEN_FILE)
column5: 1Password Service Account 令牌可被 `op` 使用（令牌文件 600；路径见 AGENT_OP_TOKEN_FILE）

column4: Claude Code is signed in
column5: Claude Code 已登录

column4: GitHub CLI is signed in
column5: GitHub CLI 已登录

column4: Global git user.name and user.email are set
column5: git 全局 user.name / user.email 已设置

column4: Docker engine answers (OrbStack started once)
column5: Docker 引擎可用（OrbStack 已首次启动）

column4: OrbStack starts at login, k8s off (subnet pinned when AGENT_ORBSTACK_SUBNET4 is set)
column5: OrbStack 登录自启、k8s 关闭（设置 AGENT_ORBSTACK_SUBNET4 时固定网段）
